reviews.independentExecution: Read-only contract/authority review; no builds/full tests/CI

scope: Documentation contract only; no runtime, real fiscal/legal values, approved business prose, official numbering, real grants or deployment.
publication: Unmodified canonical metadata manifest and report, compact technical proof/index only. Bulk inputs are exact existing public Git paths/modes/SHA256, individually validated against source bytes. Artifact hashes identify private raw logs; log bodies are not selected. No images, archives, traces, original dossier or model prose selected.
